name: Portable SDK Generic Manifest Exact Dispatch
purpose: Invoke the existing already-local sovereign source refresh plus exact sdk_generic_manifest_execution resident consumer for one manifest-bound SDK generic request, without creating another runtime, scheduler, dispatcher, request identity or authority plane.
trigger: an existing canonical Goal requires on-demand execution of the already-staged generic SDK manifest request through the existing portable resident bridge
scope: one invocation-bound local source root, one sovereign runtime root, exact sdk_generic_manifest_execution selector, and one tracking Goal/COSV
reuse_instructions: Trigger through scripts/trigger_reusable_task.py with task_id/COSV tracking. Parameters must bind source_root, runtime_root, only_consumer=sdk_generic_manifest_execution and goal_task_id. Trigger acceptance is not execution; the child consumer result and its receipt chain control all execution claims.
